title: Empirical evaluation of LLMs in predicting fixes of Configuration bugs in Smart Home System

live_model.evidence: Sec. II-C.2: "GPT4o is a cost-effective and optimized version of GPT4 ... This model is also owned as GPT-4 Turbo."; Table III row "21 17 10 11 80% 47% 52%" (GPT4o% column).

prompt.note: Four prompt variants are clearly specified as combinations of {bug description, original script, specific issue outline} plus the 8-strategy list, but the literal wording only appears as figure screenshots, not in the extracted text.

claim.location: Table III, row GPT4o%, Prompt 3 (of 4 prompt tables, II-V)

data.source: "Configuration bug dataset with predicted fix and strategies" (named/linked release); base 129 issues from the Home Assistant Community forum, from Anik et al.'s prior strategy taxonomy

notes: Authors incorrectly equate GPT-4o with "GPT-4 Turbo" (Sec. II-C.2), so the exact underlying snapshot is inferred via the post-2024-07 bare-alias date rule rather than confirmed. Plain "GPT-4" (not GPT-4o/Turbo) gets the headline 80% accuracy on Prompt 2 (Table II) but is not a pinned live id. Only n=21 debugging cases were run through all four models/prompts.
